description: This file defines the ProductViewed controller class in the Opencart admin module. It manages generating a report of viewed products, including loading necessary models and language strings, fetching product data, and handling pagination for report generation.

classes.name: ProductViewed
classes.description: Controller class responsible for generating and managing the 'Product Viewed' report in the Opencart admin interface, including handling pagination and report data collection.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method that loads language, models, manages pagination, fetches product data, updates report entries, and outputs the JSON response for the product viewed report.
